Change Log View

Dashboard changelog view.

This module provides a publicly accessible view that renders the platform changelog page. The page is served as a static HTML render of dashboard/changelog.html with no authentication requirement.

Classes:

ChangeLogView: Public view that renders the dashboard changelog page.

Example

Wire up the view in your URL configuration:

from smarter.apps.dashboard.views.views.change_log import ChangeLogView

urlpatterns = [
    path("changelog/", ChangeLogView.as_view(), name="changelog"),
]
class smarter.apps.dashboard.views.views.change_log.ChangeLogView(**kwargs)[source]

Bases: SmarterWebHtmlView

Public view that renders the dashboard changelog page.

Extends SmarterWebHtmlView and requires no authentication. Renders dashboard/changelog.html on a GET request.

template_path

"dashboard/changelog.html"

Type:

str

template_path: str = 'dashboard/changelog.html'
